milestone: DSH3-11 operator frames (schema-grounded NL edit turns)
implementation: derive_operator_frame / OperatorFrameV1 + generate_operator_nl_turns / OperatorLeakDetectorV1 / classify_state_references / build_operator_disambiguation_report / OperatorNlFixtureProviderV1
depends_on: dsl.operators.contracts+registry+references+legal_set (DSH3-01..06), dsl.paraphrase_provenance (DSH2-03, SLM-364 provider/provenance/quarantine contract reused unchanged), harnesses.train_data.operator_corpus (OperatorTargetView), CAP1 structured schema interpretation of SLM-343 (see dsl.semantic_frame)

frame_contract.required_edit_facts: every ActionEffectV1 delta (target+delta kind+before/after) plus consumed/produced roles and binders
frame_contract.forbidden_edit_facts: every reference-table entry the effect does NOT touch, claimed only under compiler_coverage=exact; empty under bounded/approximate (no overclaim)
frame_contract.state_reference_facts: bound arguments + effect targets resolved through ReferenceTableV1 typed descriptor tables; inference-visible compiler facts only; undescribed refs fail closed
frame_contract.provenance: every fact carries source (effect/argument/reference_table), slot_id, delta_kind, descriptor_fingerprint

admission.rule: admit only if the target application is in the exact OperatorLegalSetV1 and accepted set, every state reference is unambiguous or accepted-set-scored, and the prompt is not compatible with any non-equivalent application outside the accepted set; several accepted matches require the prompt to name the accepted set
admission.targets: symbol-only: reserved OPERATOR serialization, resulting canonical AST, or declared dual view; NL never enters targets

stop_rule: families whose prompts cannot be disambiguated under the current state/schema record disposition symbolic_cap2_only (fixture_ambiguous_shared_descriptor); symbolic CAP2 is retained for those families honestly
